parties: IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited (material subsidiary of Amber Enterprises India Limited) acquiring additional equity stake in Ascent Circuits Private Limited (subsidiary of IL JIN, step-down subsidiary of Amber)
headline: Amber Enterprises' IL JIN subsidiary to acquire additional 38.50% stake in Ascent Circuits, raising holding to 98.50%
sum: IL JIN Electronics, a material subsidiary of Amber Enterprises India Limited, executed Share Purchase Agreements on 18 June 2026 to acquire an additional 38.50% equity stake in Ascent Circuits Private Limited (its own subsidiary and Amber's step-down subsidiary), increasing its shareholding from 60% to 98.50%. The acquisition is proposed to be completed in one or more tranches.
detail: IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited, a material subsidiary of Amber Enterprises India Limited, executed Share Purchase Agreements with effect from 18 June 2026 to acquire an incremental 38.50% equity stake in Ascent Circuits Private Limited. This transaction will increase IL JIN's shareholding in Ascent from the existing 60% to 98.50%, effectuating an upstream consolidation of a step-down subsidiary. The acquisition is contemplated to occur in one or more tranches, suggesting a phased settlement structure. No acquisition value is disclosed in the NSE filing.
